item.title: testing markdown footnotes
item.description:
Apparently markdown support simple, automatically linked footnotes.1

  1. It works! Honestly pretty cool, better than I expected. Although this isn’t native markdown - it’s an extension. I managed to install it in my other SSG too, it’s amazing. ↩︎

item.title: Test Post
item.description:
wow

this is so fun… I’m making a website without writing code by hand, simply incredible. these framework things are amazing.. maybe I should’ve been using hugo this whole time rather than suffering through the work of handcoding layouts and setting up ultra-simple static site generators, I don’t know why I was so averse to this.. it’s not like some kind of terrible crime to have the work done for you. Besides this isn’t nearly as bad as using wordpress or something…
